label: Copy-phase update gate, recall position >= 2, favoring certain fed-back tokens (0,w,o,c,d,...)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L): 100% of activation mass, never on original-phase or delimiter steps, never at recall_idx 0 and almost never at recall_idx 1 (3% of mass, only for L=3/4). Within the copy phase it fires on only ~12% of steps; rate depends jointly on L and recall position (highest for L=3/4 at recall 1-2, the very strongest activations at t=L+2 of L=3 sequences; for L>=6 peaks at recall 3-5; rate 0 at recall 1 for L>=5) and on the fed-back input token (0, w, o, c, d highest at 2-4x lift; m, q, i low). Predicate restricting to recall_idx>=2 and the high-rate input tokens gets dev F1 ~0.40 (mass recall 0.65); adding a position table only raises F1 to 0.44. Magnitudes are tiny (max 0.01). The residual selectivity among copy-phase steps was not captured by any simple variable.
